source_text: εἰς μὲν τὴν πρώτην σκηνὴν, διὰ παντὸς εἰσίασιν οἱ ἱερεῖς τὰς λατρείας ἐπιτελοῦντες. Εἰς δὲ τὴν δευτέραν, ἅπαξ τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ μόνος ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς οὐ χωρὶς αἵματος, ὃ προσφέρει ὑπὲρ ἑαυτοῦ καὶ τῶν τοῦ λαοῦ ἀγνοημάτων, τοῦτο δηλοῦντος τοῦ ἁγίου Πν

pass_b_english: Cyril: …into the first tent, through all the priests enter performing the worships. And into the second, once of the year alone the high priest not apart from blood, which he brings forward for himself and for the ignorances of the people, this of the holy Spirit making clear that the way of the holies has not yet been manifested, while the first tent still has standing. Which is a parable unto the time that has stood in, according to which gifts and sacrifices are brought forward, not able according to conscience to perfect the one worshipping, only upon foods and drinks and differing baptisms righteous-ordinances of flesh laid on until a time of setting-upright. But Christ having arrived high priest of the coming good things through the greater and more perfect tent not hand-made—that is, not of this creation—nor through blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood has entered once-for-all into Holies of holies having found age-long ransom.’ So then you understand that the priests were performing the worships in the first tent, not having the running-in unto Holies of holies. For somehow such is the worship according to law, having standing in shadows. And these are empty toward cleansing and washing-off of sin. For you have just learned Paul crying that they have insufficiently according to conscience to perfect the one worshipping. And it was rather being kept until a time of setting-upright, clear that of the becoming-human of the Only-begotten, when the unbeauty of the types has withdrawn unto truth. ‘And once of the year and alone the high priest was running into the Holies of holies. And not apart from blood, which he was bringing forward for both himself and for the ignorances of the people.’ (Hebrews 9:6–12) And all-wise Paul will also clarify this again for us saying thus concerning Christ, ‘Saying above, that sacrifices and offerings and whole-burnt-offerings and concerning sin you did not will, nor were well-pleased, which are brought forward according to law. Then I said, Behold I have come to do your will’ (Hebrews 10:5–14); he takes away the first that he may set the second; ‘In which will we have been sanctified, through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ; and every high priest stands according to day liturgizing, and bringing forward the same sacrifices many times which are never able to take away sins, having brought forward no sacrifice for sins, unto the continual he has sat at the right of God; the rest awaiting until his enemies be set a footstool of his feet, for by one offering he has perfected unto the continual those being sanctified.’ (Romans 6:9) For having died once, he no longer dies, according to what has been written; and having borne up sins of many, he has entered into the Holies of holies—that is, into the heaven, now to be manifested to the face of God for us.

Palladius: Clear is the word; so then release the sweat upon this, and what blood again would it be which it is custom for the leader of the sacred things to bring forward for both himself and for the ignorances of the people, speak to me asking (Hebrews 9:24).
